name: Performance Tracker
description: Logs FPS, CPU and RAM over time and shows detailed stats, graphs and records per day, week, month or custom range.

issues.info: Report bugs and suggestions on the GitHub repository.

enabled.name: Enable tracking
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, nothing is measured or written to disk. Already recorded data is kept.

sample-interval.name: Sample interval (s)
sample-interval.description: How many seconds of gameplay each recorded data point covers. Lower = more precise graphs, bigger files. A sample is also closed early whenever you enter or leave a level.

flush-interval.name: Write to disk every (s)
flush-interval.description: How often buffered samples are written to disk. Lower = less data lost if the game crashes, slightly more disk writes.

track-menus.name: Track outside of levels
track-menus.description: Also record performance in menus and loading screens, not just in levels and the editor.

retention-days.name: Keep history for (days)
retention-days.description: Delete data files older than this on startup. 0 = keep everything forever.

overlay-enabled.name: Show overlay
overlay-enabled.description: Display a small live readout on top of the game.

menu-button.name: Main menu button
menu-button.description: Add the Performance Tracker button to the bottom row of the main menu.
